issues.on_page: Local Receipts -- Operation and Maintenance Tax to Users 48,645.77
issues.issue: An irrigation district O&M 'tax' levied on users' land reads like an assessment, so special assessments is arguable. The extractor already marked it review; it's a judgment call.
The rules place water and drainage districts under natural resources/conservation. Using utilities and treating the whole entity as business-type (rather than governmental) is an assumption.
No fiscal year end is printed; 2025-06-30 is assumed (stated in notes).
